thread.title: The Detective is Already Dead Season 2 • Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2 - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode and found its character interactions engaging.
One commenter considered it a particularly strong episode, while another said the second season has been enjoyable overall.
The thread had very little activity, and commenters connected that sparse discussion to the long gap since a poorly received first season despite positive feelings about the current season.
Some comments expressed weak recall of earlier characters and frustration about accidentally encountering later-season spoilers while looking them up.
